title: PostgreSQL & Event-Driven Data Architecture
description: Master relational database optimization, EXPLAIN ANALYZE query tuning, GIN/B-Tree indexing, and event-driven data modeling.
body: A comprehensive database engineering track focusing on high-performance PostgreSQL query execution, indexing strategies, schema migrations, and event streaming integration.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Database Normalization & Schema Design
lessons.body:
### The Scenario: The Anomalous Database
A developer stores user addresses as comma-separated text inside the `users` table. When a user updates their state, half the orders table breaks due to stale address strings.

### Relational Integrity (3NF):
Learn how 3rd Normal Form (3NF) eliminates data redundancy, enforces foreign key constraints, and maintains atomic columns.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.2: EXPLAIN ANALYZE & Query Plan Breakdown
lessons.body:
### The Scenario: 10-Second API Spikes
Your analytics dashboard takes 12 seconds to load. You open PostgreSQL and run `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)`:
```sql
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
SELECT * FROM articles WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY created_at DESC;
```
You discover a `Seq Scan` reading 2,000,000 table pages from disk into memory on every single HTTP request!

lessons.title: Lesson 1.3: Advanced Indexing: B-Tree, GIN, and Partial Indexes
lessons.body:
### The Solution: Targeted Indexing
Create a Partial B-Tree Index to dramatically reduce index memory footprint:
```sql
CREATE INDEX idx_articles_published 
ON articles (created_at DESC) 
WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED';
```
Query execution drops from 12,000ms to 2ms!

lessons.title: Lesson 2.1: Data Modeling for Event Streams (CloudEvents)
lessons.body:
### The Scenario: Microservice Coupling
Service A needs to notify Service B, C, and D whenever an order is placed. Direct REST calls mean Service A fails if any downstream service is slow or offline.

### The Event Streaming Solution:
Publish immutable CloudEvents 1.0 JSON payloads to Kafka topics.

lessons.title: Lesson 2.2: Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS)
lessons.body:
### The Solution: Decoupled Read/Write Paths
Separate complex query read models (Elasticsearch / Redis) from relational transactional write models (Postgres) using asynchronous event consumption.
